task: OTHRYS TRAINING L2-002. Create exactly training/level-2/L2-002-settings-store/settingsStore.mjs. Export createSettingsStore(filePath, defaults). Node ESM stdlib only. defaults must be a plain JSON-safe object and is never mutated. Return frozen API {get,set,all,reset,resetAll}. Missing override file means {} and read calls must not write. Existing malformed JSON/non-object/array, unknown override keys, or override values whose broad type differs from the corresponding default must throw Error('STATE_CORRUPT') and mutations must not overwrite it. Allowed keys are exactly Object.keys(defaults). Type classes: array, null, string, number(finite), boolean, object(plain); set unknown key => Error('UNKNOWN_SETTING'), type mismatch/non-JSON/cycle => Error('SETTING_TYPE'). get/all return deep clones so caller mutation cannot mutate defaults or persisted state. set persists only overrides, not merged defaults. reset(key) deletes that override and persists; resetAll persists {}. All mutations atomically mkdir dirname, write UTF8 JSON to unique same-directory temp, rename, cleanup temp on failure. Deterministic, no network/deps/secrets. Touch no other file.
